in_marathi.name: Kairavani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kairavani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the words 'Kamal' (lotus) and 'Aan' (born), Kairavani signifies one who is born from a lotus.
